targets.rawSql: select case status when 'success' then 1 else 0 end as status from observability.pipeline_runs where finished_at is not null order by finished_at desc limit 1
select extract(epoch from (now() - max(finished_at))) / 3600.0 as hours from observability.pipeline_runs where status = 'success'

select avg(case when status = 'pass' then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as pass_rate from observability.dbt_results where resource_type = 'test' and run_id = (select run_id from observability.pipeline_runs where finished_at is not null order by finished_at desc limit 1) having count(*) > 0

defaults.noValue: No dbt results for latest run

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(data_source, 'unknown') as source from observability.pipeline_runs where finished_at is not null order by finished_at desc limit 1

select r.batch_date::timestamptz as time, l.table_name as metric, l.rows_loaded as value from observability.load_stats l join observability.pipeline_runs r using (run_id) where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and l.status = 'success' order by 1

select r.batch_date::timestamptz as time, t.task_id as metric, t.duration_s as value from observability.task_runs t join observability.pipeline_runs r using (run_id) where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and t.duration_s is not null union all select r.batch_date::timestamptz, 'pipeline total', extract(epoch from (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) from observability.pipeline_runs r where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and r.finished_at is not null order by 1

select r.batch_date::timestamptz as time, d.node as metric, count(*) as value from observability.dbt_results d join observability.pipeline_runs r using (run_id) where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and d.resource_type = 'test' and d.status in ('fail', 'error') group by 1, 2 order by 1

select r.batch_date::timestamptz as time, 'encounters per day' as metric, k.value from observability.kpi_snapshots k join observability.pipeline_runs r using (run_id) where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and k.metric = 'encounters_per_day' order by 1

select r.batch_date::timestamptz as time, 'readmission rate' as metric, k.value from observability.kpi_snapshots k join observability.pipeline_runs r using (run_id) where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and k.metric = 'readmission_rate_30d' order by 1

select r.batch_date::timestamptz as time, replace(k.metric, 'avg_claim_cost:', '') as metric, k.value from observability.kpi_snapshots k join observability.pipeline_runs r using (run_id) where $__timeFilter(r.batch_date::timestamptz) and k.metric like 'avg_claim_cost:%' order by 1

with latest as (select run_id from observability.pipeline_runs order by started_at desc limit 1) select case when count(c.rule) = 0 then 'no results' when count(c.rule) filter (where c.failing_rows > 0 and c.severity = 'error') > 0 then 'errors' when count(c.rule) filter (where c.failing_rows > 0) > 0 then 'warnings' else 'pass' end as level from latest left join observability.contract_results c on c.run_id = latest.run_id group by latest.run_id

with latest as (select run_id from observability.pipeline_runs order by started_at desc limit 1) select c.severity, c.table_name as "table", nullif(c.column_name, '') as "column", c.rule, c.failing_rows as "failing rows", array_to_string(c.examples, ', ') as examples from observability.contract_results c join latest on c.run_id = latest.run_id where c.failing_rows > 0 order by c.severity, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.rule
